end.summary: Practised physical and chemical changes, including reversibility and formation of new substances.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes by checking whether the substance stays the same and whether the change can be reversed. They recognised chemical-change signs such as smell change, colour change, and formation of a new solid. There was initial confusion about melting ice and ghee, but this was corrected later by explaining that the same substance remains and can return to its original state. At home, ask Ananya to sort everyday examples into physical or chemical changes and explain the clue used.
